def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(n) for c in range(n) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    h, w = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1

    # The marked square covers a patch; recover it from the corresponding
    # patch reflected through the center of the grid.
    return [
        [grid[n - 1 - r][n - 1 - c] for c in range(c1, c0 - 1, -1)]
        for r in range(r1, r0 - 1, -1)
    ]

def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    marked = [(r, c) for r in range(n) for c in range(n) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in marked), max(r for r, c in marked)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in marked), max(c for r, c in marked)
    h, w = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1

    # The 3-block masks a patch. Restore it using the half-turn symmetric
    # counterpart in the patterned grid.
    return [
        [grid[n - 1 - (r0 + i)][n - 1 - (c0 + j)] for j in range(w)]
        for i in range(h)
    ]
